That belief sparked Freshworks. And it powers everything we do and build today. Trusted by 74,000+ businesses worldwide Enterprise capability without enterprise complexity We’re on a mission to help every business struggling under the weight of bloated, overpromised software. The kind that calls complexity “added value.” That force-fits teams with features they’ll never use. That measures implementation in months and results in years. We see you. Agents buried in clunky workflows. Leaders fed up with legacy. Teams who deserve better. There’s another way. Freshworks. We help you untangle the knots left behind by outdated systems and outdated thinking. We celebrate you when you see ROI today—not someday. We craft code that simplifies. Use AI that amplifies. Solve service challenges without making new ones. Create software that makes, not breaks, your business. We’re ready to deliver. Modern and intuitive IT service management Explore Freshservice Effortless customer service and support Explore Freshdesk What makes us different We’re driven to uncomplicate work so teams can do more of what matters. Uncomplicated solutions Our enterprise-grade solutions are designed to be easy to implement, use, and configure.

We make work easier and processes less complex. Rapid impact Our software makes a real difference in days or weeks, not months let alone years. 

We enable fast and accurate service that customers and employees love. People-first AI Our AI-assisted software is a force-multiplier, meant to help people deliver exceptional service.

We put our customers first, always. No surprises Our reliable products,  transparent pricing, and honest people won’t surprise you with exorbitant costs.
